data.name: PRO: Push React Outgun
data.detailed_description:
PRO: Push React Outgun is a tactical multiplayer FPS designed to push the boundaries of combat and drop players directly into the heart of modern battlefields...

The Story

Following a nuclear catastrophe, all water sources have been contaminated and energy reserves rendered useless. Currently, drinkable water is only obtained by desalinating seawater, a process that requires a nuclear element known as "nit." Those in power employ mercenaries known as Enforcers to secure this resource, while the common people, known as Raiders, attempt to seize it through strategic raids.

Redefining Combat

The moment you step onto the battlefield, you will be immersed in chaos and realism. Close-quarters combat is about more than just rapid firing; you must hold the right angles, coordinate with teammates, and maintain strict trigger discipline. A single mistake can decide the entire round. PRO forces you to slow down, think, and execute your moves like a professional.

Key Features

  • Next-Gen UE5 Visuals: Environment design equipped with advanced lighting, Nanite technology, and realistic materials to maximize your situational awareness.

  • Heavy and Realistic Weapon Mechanics: Grounded gameplay where recoil, timing, and discipline define the thin line between survival and death.

  • Environmental Audio Experience: Track your enemies' every footstep through acoustic resonance and audio occlusion systems. He who listens, wins.

  • Tactics First, Reflexes Second: Win rounds through coordination or snatch victory from impossible moments with razor-sharp reflexes.

  • Map Design: Layered and detailed maps that punish careless movement and reward precise advancement.

Early Access Roadmap

We are growing alongside our community. Planned improvements include performance optimization, network stability, automated matchmaking, and balance updates.

  • Rank System: Determine your global standing through a ranking system and international statistics.

  • Matchmaking: Encounter players of your own skill level with automated matchmaking.

  • Expanded Content: New game modes and diverse maps will be added to differentiate your combat experience.

  • The Nit Economy: After every battle, the winning team will be rewarded with "nit."

  • Weapon Customization: Use "nit" to equip your weapons with scopes, red dots, suppressors, flash hiders, and more.

  • Character Customization: Customize your character with new outfits, camouflage, tactical vests, and various cosmetic upgrades using your earned "nit."

  • Localization: Support for 15+ subtitles and languages will be added.

  • Arsenal Expansion: We plan to introduce more weapon options and a deeper realism experience.

Early Access Note

PRO: Push React Outgun is currently under active development. At this stage, only the Casual mode is available. The version you play today is a strong foundation that will continuously evolve. Your feedback helps us determine our priorities and perfect the feel of the game. Tell us what works, what needs improvement, and what you want to see next.

Please keep in mind that this game is being developed by a single individual, and the development process reflects this. We would like to thank our entire community for standing by us in this passionate independent development journey and for believing in our project.

content_descriptors.notes: This title offers an intense combat atmosphere featuring realistic firearm mechanics and military operations. Throughout the general gameplay, violence and blood effects are integral parts of the visual experience, reflecting the nature of the struggle. Due to these dynamics and the high level of excitement, the game is designed with an adult audience in mind. We strongly recommend that minor users experience this atmosphere under parental supervision and in a controlled manner. In this world where strategic moves and tactical precision are paramount, our goal is to ensure a conscious and responsible gaming experience.
